subject: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence bundling + short-notice burst seats
messages:
From: Leah Moss <leah.moss@charlietech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@charlietech.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation timing + capacity ask for renewal

Hi Naomi,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're kicking off our vendor recertification for Q2 renewal and had a couple of asks up front:

- Can you confirm the earliest window to hand off SOC 2 artifacts (evidence index + logs) to our auditor (Thompson)? We were hoping for a bulk transfer week the week of May 10.
- Our usage has spiked; if we renew for a 12-month term we may want a short-notice burst of an extra 50k tokens/day for 2 weeks in July — can that be scoped in the contract/price?

We want to avoid gaps in the audit timeline and also understand pricing for temporary capacity. Attaching a short intake of what the auditor will need.

Thanks —
Leah Moss
Vendor Risk Manager
CharlieTech

Attachment: audit_requirements_charlietech.pdf (stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Leah Moss <leah.moss@charlietech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation timing + capacity ask for renewal

Hi Leah — thanks for the heads-up and the attachment. Short answers up front:

1) Bulk evidence handoff: we can commit to a staging transfer starting May 10; we'll provide an evidence index and a mapped log export (see manifest) by May 12, with a secure transfer to Thompson's SFTP or shared Drive (your preference).

2) Short-notice burst: yes — we can define a burst band in the order form. For a 2-week 50k tokens/day burst we typically offer a temporary uplift at a blended rate; I'll loop in pricing.

I'll coordinate with Karthik on the evidence export format and with Logan on the contract language for the burst seats. Will share a one-page mutual action plan by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Renewals (Sales)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Leah Moss <leah.moss@charlietech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Thompson & Co. Auditors <audit@thompson-llp.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation timing + capacity ask for renewal

Hi all — attaching a proposed evidence index and a sample log_manifest for the export. Key notes:

- Evidence index (soc2_evidence_index.xlsx) maps control IDs to artifacts. We'll mark any items that require redaction or handling (e.g., customer PII).
- Log export: we can produce an S3-compatible export in two slices: app access logs and inference audit logs. The manifest includes time ranges and estimated compressed sizes; bulk transfer should be 2–3 business days to seed Thompson's bucket once we start.

On retention: CharlieTech requested a 24-month searchable retention instead of our default 12-month. We can offer 24 months as a term amendment (adds a modest storage surcharge). If the retention change is accepted, we'll include the additional cost in the renewal quote.

Regarding the burst seats: Logan — can you add a contract clause that allows up to +50k tokens/day for 14 consecutive days with a 72-hour notice? Also include a one-time activation fee.

Thanks,
Karthik (Security & Compliance lead)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: soc2_evidence_index.xlsx (stub); log_export_manifest.json (stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Leah Moss <leah.moss@charlietech.com>, procurement@charlietech.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation timing + capacity ask for renewal

Thanks Karthik — quick update on the commercial side:

- I can add a "Burst Band" clause to the order form: +50k tokens/day for up to 14 days with 72-hour notice. Activation fee: $1,200 per activation. If CharlieTech prefers a guaranteed 2-week committed uplift we can do a short-term addendum with a lower per-token uplift.
- Retention: 24-month searchable retention is available as a term amendment; estimated incremental storage charge: $550/month. I'll put both options in the draft and mark the price rows as optional for easy toggling in procurement.

Leah/procurement — would you prefer the reserved short-term addendum (cheaper overall) or the on-demand burst band (flexible but slightly higher per-token cost)?

Logan Wright
Head of Deals
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf (contains both pricing options)

From: Leah Moss <leah.moss@charlietech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@charlietech.com, Thompson & Co. Auditors <audit@thompson-llp.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation timing + capacity ask for renewal

Appreciate the quick turn — procurement prefers the reserved 2-week addendum if possible (predictable TCO) and the 24-month retention. Two asks before we sign:

1) Can Thompson get the staged log export (read-only access) by May 12? They need at least the May 10 seed plus manifest to begin their sampling.
2) Can we get a clause that the burst activation must not be used for model fine-tuning or export of customer payloads (this is a compliance constraint on our side)?

If you can confirm both, procurement will route the order for signatures next week.

Thanks —
Leah
Vendor Risk Manager
CharlieTech
